主要内容: On February 14, 2019, the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors of Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. set the base compensation of Robert J. Pallé, the Company’s President and Chief Executive Officer, at $328,000 per year, retroactive to January 1, 2019. The Committee also determined that the previously-reported bonus payment to Mr. Pallé, which was to be paid in connection with the completion of the sale of the Company’s Old Bridge Facility, was calculated incorrectly. The bonus payable to Mr. Pallé is $185,000, not the previously-reported amount of $165,000.
